title: time-varying value relevance of advertising expenditures around the covid-19 pandemic: evidence from the korean stock market
core_idea: Examine how the relationship between advertising intensity (advertising expenses/sales) and firm value (proxied by Tobin's Q) for Korean listed companies changed across pre‑COVID (2018–2019), during‑COVID (2020–2021), and post‑COVID (2022–2023) periods using multiple regression models with interaction terms and firm-level controls (leverage, profitability, growth potential, governance).
tldr: Study investigates whether and how advertising spending relates to firm value across pre-, during-, and post-COVID-19 phases in Korea (2018–2023), measuring advertising intensity and Tobin's Q and analyzing dynamics with controlled regression models.
